test_rotate_transform: test the Rotate augmentation transform with various angle, center, and probability configurations
construct_toy_data: create toy detection data with images, bounding boxes, labels, masks, and semantic segmentation
check_rotate: verify rotated results match expected ground truth for images, bboxes, masks, and segmentations
test_rotate_with_bitmap_masks: test the Rotate transform using BitmapMasks for ground truth mask augmentation
test_rotate_with_polygon_masks: test the Rotate transform using PolygonMasks for ground truth mask augmentation
